criterion.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature 634:210-219, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9, Methods: 'We chose Wsyn such that activation of sugar GRNs at 100 Hz resulted in roughly 80% of maximal MN9 firing' (refs 64, 65 = Dahanukar et al. 2007; Inagaki et al. 2012)
criterion.note: Shiu et al. applied it to FlyWire v630 (female brain, Brian2 PoissonInput with the targets' refractory period set to 0); here it is applied to MaleCNS with FlyLab forced spikes

definitions.M: mean over seeds of the readout population's whole-run mean rate (Hz)
definitions.D1: F = M(w, r_ref) / max over swept rates of M(w, r)  [primary]
definitions.D2: F = M(w, r_ref) / M(w, r_max) with r_max the highest swept rate
definitions.D3: as D1 but at the requested rate whose achieved stimulus rate is closest to r_ref: 125.0 Hz requested -> 98.7 Hz achieved
definitions.uncertainty: percentile interval over 10000 joint resamples of the 5 seeds (same seeds at every rate), confidence 0.95

selected.note: selected = swept level nearest the target; interpolation for information only (F need not be monotonic in w_syn)
